name: @arkade-os/wdk
description: WDK (Wallet Development Kit) implementation using Arkade Bitcoin SDK with Ark protocol support
overridesNote: Pin bare-* native addons to versions that react-native-bare-kit actually ships in its libs/jni directory. Without these pins the worklet bundle requests addon versions the host doesn't have and require.addon() throws ADDON_NOT_FOUND at runtime. Only pin packages we've verified the dep tree tolerates downgrading — some bare-* packages bumped their internal file layout between minor versions, so naive pinning breaks the bundle (e.g. bare-performance 1.3.0 → 1.2.0 removes lib/constants which dependents still require). Inspect the host's bundled .so files in node_modules/react-native-bare-kit/android/build/intermediates/library_jni/.../jni/arm64-v8a/ to find safe versions. Other addons (bare-buffer, bare-fs, bare-os, bare-pipe, bare-signals, bare-tcp, bare-tls, bare-tty, bare-url, bare-performance) have version mismatches in the bundle but only crash at runtime if their code paths are actually exercised — add overrides reactively as those errors surface.
